what_this_is: The committed attestation record of the once-only E1 (EFL Championship) acquisition, executed standalone under the owner's 2026-08-30 E1 SPLIT ruling. Design reference: reports/epl_lowerdiv_prereg.md v2 at d20a13a (its §2/§0.6 ingest rulings and its §8.10 attestation shape). THIS IS NOT THE LOWER-DIVISION EXPERIMENT: no fit, no store build, no harness, no estimand. Nothing here is evidence for or against that hypothesis.

acquisition_timestamps.note: The fetch pass ran once, sequentially, with a 3-second pace between requests. A second run of the identical pass returned from_cache=True for all twelve with identical digests and issued no request — recorded below as cache_first_reverified.

validation.rule: per-division constants, E1 = (24 clubs, 552 matches, 23 opponents)

unmapped.rule: A residual unmapped name is a STOP, never a silent skip. epl.teams.resolve raises UnknownTeamError, and for a non-E0 division a null club key raises epl.parse.PhantomClub BEFORE the frame exists, so epl.fit.to_store_frame's astype(str) — which would turn a null key into the phantom club 'None' — is unreachable on this build's call graph.
unmapped.registry_extension_note: None was needed. The enumeration published at 7e87828 before the registry commit matched the measured census exactly: all 49 spellings, every index fold, every stable key, every spelling's per-season presence and every season's 24-club membership.

archive.gitignored_note: data/ is gitignored in full, so the archive itself is not committed; this record is what a reader checks it against, and the twelve source digests plus `python -m epl.build --division E1` rebuild it.

e0_untouched.elo_anchor_note: This build produces an archive and stops. No anchor, fit, store, forecast or simulation input is written, and epl/elo.py is not edited. matches_e1.parquet has no reader in the repository.

outcome_summary_WITHHELD.requested_by_the_task: the E1 goal rate vs E0's
outcome_summary_WITHHELD.why: The task's design reference is reports/epl_lowerdiv_prereg.md v2 at d20a13a, and v2 FORBIDS exactly this statistic before the experiment's freeze. §0.6: 'NO OUTCOME SUMMARY OF THE TREATMENT DATA MAY BE PUBLISHED BEFORE THE FREEZE, AND THE GOAL RATE IS THE CASE THAT MATTERS.' §8.10's allow-list 'contains no scores, no goal counts, no goal rates, no result distribution and no derived outcome statistic of any kind.' §10 makes publishing one an INVALIDATION: 'Any outcome summary of the treatment data — a goal rate, a score distribution, any statistic derived from a match result — is published before the freeze, in a §8.10 note or anywhere else.'
outcome_summary_WITHHELD.provenance_of_the_conflict: 'measure the E1 goal rate against E0's and publish it' is v1's requirement, quoted verbatim in v2 §0.6. It was DELETED by blocking review finding B4 (v2 §11: 'B4 §0.6, §8.3, §8.10 — the goal rate moves after the freeze, and the note has an allow-list'). The task instruction reproduces the superseded v1 language while naming v2 as the design reference; the two cannot both be honoured.
outcome_summary_WITHHELD.how_it_was_resolved: By the reversible option, and by the named reference. The E1 SPLIT ruling states the confirmatory experiment HOLDS and that this note 'changes only where the acquisition executes' — so §10 still binds. Publishing the rate cannot be undone: the invalidation is that the author saw the treatment's outcomes while the operative law was still editable, which a later revert does not repair. Withholding it costs one command whenever the owner rules otherwise. The rate was therefore never computed — not printed, not logged, not stored.
outcome_summary_WITHHELD.where_it_belongs: reports/epl_lowerdiv_result.md, after the freeze, per v2 §9.4 and §2.2 — or in a standalone record on an explicit owner ruling that the split releases the acquisition from §10.

scope.ruling: owner, 2026-08-30, E1 SPLIT: the Championship archive is built now as standalone infrastructure; the confirmatory experiment holds and, when revived, pins this archive as-found.
